title: surge.t1 hunk declares 4007 new lines but chunk presents only 2006 with no truncation marker
detail: Hunk header claims 4,007 added lines; chunk shows 2,006 (sequence 1995 through 4000). 2,001 lines of the new file are absent with no ellipsis or marker, so the chunk is not a well-formed patch and cannot be reviewed or applied as-is.
recommended_fix: Regenerate chunk c5 including the full surge.t1 file, or mark the omission explicitly with a `<snip>` indicator and corrected hunk counts.

title: Surge screenshot filenames use variable-width ms timestamps; lexicographic order is not chronological
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/surge/119500ms.png b/goldens/surge/119500ms.png
diff --git a/goldens/surge/149000ms.png b/goldens/surge/149000ms.png
diff --git a/goldens/surge/170000ms.png b/goldens/surge/170000ms.png
diff --git a/goldens/surge/30000ms.png b/goldens/surge/30000ms.png
diff --git a/goldens/surge/65000ms.png b/goldens/surge/65000ms.png
detail: The diff itself lists screenshots alphabetically, which orders 119500ms before 30000ms. Any tooling that globs goldens/surge/*.png to build a timeline or compare frames gets a non-chronological sequence.
recommended_fix: Zero-pad timestamps to a fixed width (e.g., 030000ms.png, 065000ms.png, 119500ms.png) so lexicographic order matches chronological order.
